observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoors by a riverbank in a tropical village setting in Pahang, Malaysia, with musicians seated on an elevated platform and dancers performing on the sand.
observation.dancers: Five young male dancers wearing turtle shells on their backs, accompanied by an older man and an audience seated nearby.
observation.formation_and_space: Group formation on sand near a riverbank, kneeling and shifting positions in relation to a musician platform and a man acting as a fisherman.
observation.posture: Dancers maintain a low, crouching posture on their knees, mimicking turtles.
observation.footwork: Kneeling and shifting on knees in the sand; precise stepping cannot be seen as feet are obscured by costumes and sand.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held low near the body with palms facing down, making gentle flapping or paddling gestures.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso leans forward; slight side-to-side body sways and head tilts mimicking turtle movements.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level throughout, performed entirely on knees and crouching positions; no jumps or turns visible.
observation.costume_and_props: Brown and reddish traditional outfits with sarongs and headbands (tengkolok); large circular brown shell props worn on their backs resembling turtle shells.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork and weight transfer cannot be seen because dancers perform kneeling on sand.
